title: Support SNEStorage
introduction: Help us improve SNEStorage and keep building tools and projects for the Super Nintendo community.
patreonDescription: SNEStorage is created and developed by anonimzwx. If you enjoy the website or the SNES work behind it, supporting my Patreon helps me dedicate more time to improving the site and developing new tools, resources, and projects.
linkNote: Opens Patreon in a new tab. You can review the available membership options there.
unavailableText: The support link is currently unavailable. Please try again later.

benefits.title: Supporter channels on Discord
benefits.text: Get access to dedicated supporter channels in the SNEStorage Discord community.

benefits.title: Help shape what comes next
benefits.text: Vote on selected future projects and improvements to the SNEStorage website.

benefits.title: External emojis
benefits.text: Get permission to use emojis from other Discord servers in the SNEStorage Discord.

sectionsTitle: What your support helps us build

sections.title: A better SNEStorage
sections.text: More time to improve the website, refine its features, and make sharing and finding SNES resources easier.

sections.title: More tools for creators
sections.text: Development of tools and systems that help SNES creators bring their ideas to life.

sections.title: New SNES projects
sections.text: More room to experiment with custom sprites, bosses, gameplay systems, and other projects for the Super Nintendo.

thanksTitle: Thank you for being part of this
thanksText: Financial support is completely optional. Sharing your resources, reporting issues, and helping other creators also make a difference.
